description.fallback: With the star being stolen, the group has no leads on the mysterious thief who can use chakra to fly. Naruto learns that Sumaru's parents died defending the star from a foreign ninja. Tenten and Lee attempt to track two of Akahoshi's men, but they are discovered and find no answers.
